name: session-glance
description: A pane with a rolling status of the session, the agent's tasks and your own to-dos

renameSession.title: Rename the session
renameSession.description: Set the session's title in the session list to the status title Haiku writes. Off keeps the app's own title.

suggestTitle.title: Suggest a new title when the work moves on
suggestTitle.description: While Rename the session is off: when the session's work as a whole has moved away from its title, the pane suggests a fitting one to use or dismiss.

autoSummary.title: Update the status after every answer
autoSummary.description: One small model call per answered turn. Off: the status only changes on /glance refresh.

checkTasks.title: Check tasks you type
checkTasks.description: Have the model tidy a typed task and ask when it is unclear or a duplicate. Off adds tasks as typed.

summaryModel.title: Model for the status and task checks
summaryModel.description: haiku is fast and cheap; sonnet writes sharper summaries at a higher cost.
